plc.title: PLC (Modbus TCP)
plc.intro: {gates} albaab joojin ayaa amarradooda furid iyo xirid ka qaata PLC. PLC wuxuu akhrisaa indhaha dhalaalka iyo tirooyinka, wuxuuna qoraa koyliyada albaabbada; moodeelku wuxuu ku shaqeeyaa xawaaraha saacadda. Habku waa kinematik: PLC ma dhigi karo suunka xawaare ka weyn.
plc.nogate: Dhig habka albaab joojin "PLC ayaa dejiya" si PLC uu u maamulo. Indhaha dhalaalka horeba waa la akhriyi karaa.
plc.start.hint: Studio wuxuu kompyuutarkan ku dhegaysanayaa PLC (Modbus TCP) inta socodka tooska ah socdo
plc.studio: PLC wuxuu ku xidhmaa CadCraft Studio, kaas oo furaya socketka kompyuutarkan. Halkan waxaad ku kaydin kartaa liiska cinwaanada barnaamijeeyaha PLC.
plc.listening: Waxaa la sugayaa PLC kompyuutarkan, albaabka {port}.
plc.nolink: Daaqaddan ma laha xidhiidh PLC (isticmaal CadCraft Studio ee desktop-ka).

play.full: Raadraaca way buuxsamtay hore: dib u daahintu way joogsanaysaa ka hor taas.

pools.title: Kooxaha shaqaalaha
pools.note: Koox dad ah oo istaysanyo wada isticmaalaan. Istaysan magaca koox qoraysa waxay u baahan tahay hal qof oo ka mid ah kooxdaas loo shubo kasta oo uu adeego; haddii aan qof fadhiyo, shubku wuu sugayaa.

robot.title: Unugga robotka
robot.none: Weli robot ma jiro. Ku dar unug si aad u hubiso istaysanyada uu gaadhi karo iyo inta uu qaadista iyo dhigista qaadanayo.
robot.envelope: Wuxuu gaadhayaa {min} m ilaa {max} m ka fogaan saldhigga shaqada heerka shaqada.
robot.envelopeNone: Waxba ma gaadhi karo xagalka koowaad heerka shaqada.
robot.reach.empty: Ku dar istaysanyo, kaydka dhexe, ilo ama meelo dhigis si aad u hubiso.

robot.why.limits: ka baxsan xadka laf-jiifka ama heerka
robot.why.orientation: qalabku meeshaas kor uma tilmaami karo
robot.stopped: Waa joogsatay {s} s kadib: barnaamijka lama dhammayn karo.
robot.useCycle: Isticmaal waqtiga wareegga sidii waqtiga istaysanka

robot.issue.path-unreachable: Safka {line}: jidka toosan ee loo maro {target} wuxuu ka baxayaa gaadhida boqolkiiba {at} ({why}).
robot.issue.joint-jump: Safka {line}: jidka toosan ee loo maro {target} wuxuu u baahan yahay in laf-jiifku rogmado boqolkiiba {at} (ku dhow xaddidaadda).
robot.issue.no-target: Safka {line}: ma jiro barta ama istaysanka magaceeda {target}.
robot.note: Dhaqdhaqaaqa kaliya: ma hubinayo dhacdooyinka, miisaanka ama dynamics-ka. Waqtiyadu waxay isticmaalaan xadka xawaaraha iyo degdegga laf-jiif kasta; waa qiyaas qorshe, ma aha tirada kontoroolka iibiyaha. Barnaamijku waa qaab qoraal dhexdhexaad ah; luqadda wax soo saare robot ma qoro.
robotx.table: Miiska isku-xidhka robotka (la wax ka beddeli karo)
robotx.table.dh: Hal safka isku-xidh kasta, Denavit-Hartenberg-ka caadiga ah: dhererka xidhka a, leexashada alpha, kala-guurka d, kala-guurka xagga, ka dibna xuduudaha isku-xidhka iyo xuduudaha xawaareed. Isbeddelada ayaa isla markiiba dhaqan galaya oo waxaa lagu kaydiyaa dukumentiga.
robotx.table.scara: Laba dherer oo gacan ah, kala-duwanaanta dhererka jiidka, iyo labada kala-duwanaanta xagalka gacanta.
robotx.table.delta: Cabirrada saldhigga iyo madaxa, dhererka gacanta iyo ulaha (Clavel), iyo kala-duwanaanta dhererka shaqada (tabta: ka hooseeya saldhigga).
robotx.table.cartesian: Kala-duwanaanta socodka jiid kasta marka loo eego nidaamka robotka.
robotx.fmt.title: Qaababka barnaamijka
robotx.fmt.hint: Dooro faylalka loo kaydinayo unugan. Liistada jidka had iyo jeer way kaydsamaysaa. Doorashadaadu waxay la socotaa dukumentiga waxayna noqotaa caadigaaga.
robotx.fmt.unverified: Barnaamijyada luqadda robotka waa kuwo yar oo aan la hubin: waxaa lagu abuuray moodeelka kor ku jira, CadCraft ma socodsiiso robot. Ku daji oo hubi kontoroolka robotkaaga ka hor intaadan socodsiin. Ma jiro shirkad robot ah oo ansixisay.

plcmode.title: Qaabka PLC
plcmode.mode.real: Dhab ah (PLC oo ku xiran Modbus TCP)
plcmode.safety.title: Tijaabo kaliya.
plcmode.safety: Waligaa ha socodsiin qalab dhab ah oo kaaga maqan tijaabintan, waligaana ha isku halayn amniga: joogsiga degdegga ah halkan waa geli tijaabo. Waxa uu ku dhacayo PLC-ga la xiray adiga ayaa mas'uul ka ah.
plcmode.loading: Waxaa la soo rarayaa matoorka PLC jilicsan...
plcmode.noengine: Matoorka PLC jilicsan (Digital twin files) lama soo rari karin dhismahan, sidaas darteed qaabka PLC halkan ma socon karo.
plcmode.tags: Tagyada {inputs} waxay ka gudbaan moodeelka PLC-da (indhaha sawirka, akhrinta albaabbada, tirinta); {outputs} ayaa dib u imanaya (amarrada furista albaabbada).
plcmode.nogate: Weli ma jiro albaab joog ah qaabka PLC. Qaabka albaab kasta u deji "Ay dejisay PLC" si kontoroolku u wadi karo.
plcmode.soft.intro: PLC jilicsan wuxuu barnaamijkaaga ku socodsiiyaa moodeelka, daaqaddan ama Studio-da, adigoon qalab lahayn. Qor Structured Text (IEC 61131-3) ama ku dheji PLCopen XML. Barnaamij la'aan barnaamijka bilowga ah ayaa la isticmaalaa.
plcmode.soft.run.hint: La soo celin karo: isla barnaamijka iyo seed-ka isla natiijo ayuu siinayaa, wuxuuna ka dhakhsaysan yahay wakhtiga dhabta ah
plcmode.soft.attach.hint: Marka hore bilow Live ee Run; markaas PLC jilicsanku wuxuu sawiraa isagoo raacaya saacadda moodeelka
plcmode.soft.attached: PLC jilicsan ayaa wadaya albaabbada socodka tooska ah.
plcmode.soft.ended: Socodka tooska ah wuu dhammaaday, sidaas darteed PLC jilicsan wuu joogsaday.
plcmode.soft.ran: Waxaa la socodsiiyay 10 daqiiqo oo wakhtiga moodeelka ah.
plcmode.needLive: Marka hore bilow Live ee Run: PLC wuxuu la hadlaa moodeelka intuu ku socdo xawaareta saacadda.
plcmode.needAck: Marka hore calaamadee sanduuqa: tijaabo kaliya, adiguna waad mas'uul tahay.
plcmode.real.intro: Moodeelku wuxuu ciyaarayaa warshadda, PLC dhab ahna wuxuu ciyaarayaa kontoroolka. Wareeg kasta sensarada moodeelka waxaa lagu qoraa coils-ka iyo registers-ka PLC-da, coils-ka wax-soo-saarka PLC-da waxaa dib loogu akhriyaa albaabbada. Studio ayaa furta xiriirka; PLC-gu waa inuu ku jiraa kombiyuutarkan ama shabakad gaar ah.
plcmode.real.browser: Qaabka dhabta ah wuxuu u baahan yahay CadCraft Studio: tab-ka browser-ka ma furi karo xiriir TCP oo caadi ah. Qaabka jilicsan halkan si buuxda ayuu u shaqeeyaa.
plcmode.real.oldStudio: CadCraft Studio-kan weli ma leh macmiil PLC; wuxuu u baahan yahay dhismaha 0.9. Qaabka jilicsan halkan ayuu shaqeeyaa.
plcmode.hostNote: Cinwaanka iyo dekeddu waxay ku sii jiraan kombiyuutarkan. Lama kaydiyo faylka moodeelka, ma jiro erayga sirta ah: Modbus TCP ma leh mid.
plcmode.problem.unknown_tag: {tag}: qaabeynta ma leh tag sidaas ah.
plcmode.problem.wrong_direction: {tag}: jihada ma sax u aha tagkan.
plcmode.problem.wrong_table: {tag}: Studio wuxuu qoraa coils iyo holding registers oo keliya.
plcmode.problem.bad_type: {tag}: coil ama gelinta kala-soocan waxay haysaa bit.
plcmode.problem.overlap: {tag}: tag kale ayaa isla cinwaankaas ku jira.
plcmode.ack: Waan fahmay: tijaabo kaliya, waligeed ha socodsiin adigoon joogin, adiguna waad mas'uul ka tahay waxa PLC-gu sameeyo.
plcmode.real.connect.hint: Waxay u baahan tahay socod tooska ah, khariidad nadiif ah iyo sanduuqa la calaamadeeyay
plcmode.real.on: Waa lagu xiray {host}:{port}. Albaabbadu waxay raacayaan PLC-da.
plcmode.real.off: Xiriirka waa la jaray. Albaabbadu waa xirani.
plcmode.real.ended: Socodka tooska ah wuu dhammaaday, sidaas darteed xiriirka PLC waa la xiray.
plcmode.real.lost: Xiriirka PLC wuu lumay ({why}). Albaabbadu waa xirani.
plcmode.note: PLC ma dhaqaajin karo dhuumaha si ka dhakhsaysan; shixnadaha waxay u dhaqaaqaan si kinematic ah. Tani ma aha hubinta amniga.
problem.orders-missing: {id} waxaa loo dejiyay inuu dalabyada ka qaato fayl, laakiin miis dalab ah looma dooran. Fur fayl dalab ah qaybta Dalabyada oo halkan ku dooro.
problem.orders-empty: {id} waxaa loo dejiyay inuu dalabyada ka qaato fayl, laakiin miiskuna safaf uma lahan (safka aan tiirka isha lahayn wuxuu u gudbaa isha kasta oo noocaas ah).
orders.title: Dalabyo faylka ka timaada
orders.note: Imaanshaha fayl CSV ah halkii wakhti random ah: deji isha si ay u noqoto Dalabyo faylka ka timaada oo dooro miiska. Safka koowaad wuxuu magacaabaa tiirarka: time_s, time_min, time_h ama time (imminka uu yimaado, laga bilaabo bilowga socodka), ama clock (h:mm:ss, laga bilaabo safka koowaad); type, length_m ama length_mm, qty, source (aqoonsiga isha) iyo order (calaamad). Tiirka wakhtiga oo keliya ayaa loo baahan yahay. Isla faylka wuxuu siiyaa socod isku mid ah. Haddii safka aan la akhrin karin, waxba lama soo rarayo oo safka khaladka ah ee ugu horreeya ayaa la muujinayaa.
